description: Service conditions of Precellence Service, generated from the tariff and rules in force: vehicle classes (passengers, luggage, minimum fare, hourly rate), fixed-price zones, long distance, hourly hire, options, waiting time, cancellation and refunds, booking notice, payment (website only), contacts and links. Read-only; no booking, no payment. FR : conditions du service. AR : شروط الخدمة. ES : condiciones del servicio.

lang.description: Language of labels. One of the 7 website languages: fr, en, ar, es, tr, ru, zh. Texts exist in fr, en, ar, es; tr, ru, zh get English texts (field "lang" of the answer = language served). Names read from the tariff (classes, zones, destinations) that have no version in the language served are given in English and flagged by "name_lang". Booking link: booking form in fr, en, ar, es; English booking form for tr, ru, zh.
